items.title: Gold Steadies Near $4,000 as Inflation Keeps Rate-Hike Bets Firm
items.description: Gold steadied near $4,000 an ounce, and was on track for a second monthly loss, as energy-led inflation raised the prospects for a US rate increase before year-end.

items.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Yuan Gaining 10% as Global Push Deepens
items.description: China’s push to internationalize the yuan has entered a “steady, slow, but nonstop” phase that is likely to support further gains in the currency, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.

items.title: Vale Iron Ore Output Trails Forecast on Serra Norte Challenges
